# Hareb Digital

> Independent digital studio of Issa Hareb, based in Essen, Germany. Services: bespoke web design and development, website redesign, technical SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and workflow automation.

## Canonical website and languages
- [Deutsch](https://hareb.digital/): Primary German home page, services, selected work and visible questions and answers.
- [English](https://hareb.digital/en/): English home page.
- [Español](https://hareb.digital/es/): Spanish home page.

## Services
- [Webdesign & Entwicklung](https://hareb.digital/leistungen/neue-website/): Bespoke websites, responsive design and technical SEO.
- [Website-Relaunch](https://hareb.digital/leistungen/website-ueberarbeiten/): Review and improve an existing website.
- [Automatisierung](https://hareb.digital/leistungen/automatisierung/): Connect recurring business workflows and existing tools.
- [SEO & AEO](https://hareb.digital/leistungen/gefunden-werden/): Technical discoverability, site structure and clear answers.

## Selected work
- [Taxi B&B Essen](https://www.taxibbessen.de/): Client website with booking flow, management tools, automated emails and local SEO.
